title: v0.33.3-rc2: gemma4: image and audio input support
description: Safetensors gemma4 imports served by the MLX engine now answer image and audio chats. Images run through both vision architectures: the transformer tower (26B, 31B, e-series) and the 12B's encoder-free unified embedder. Audio arrives through the same intake the ollama API already accepts for gemma4 GGUFs — WAV bytes in the images field, OpenAI input_audio parts, and /v1/audio/transcriptions uploads — with the e2b/e4b checkpoints running clips through their conformer audio encoder and the 12b uni
